title: Shinonome Akito — Words I Never Thought I'd Hear〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Words I Never Thought I'd Hear（4★）

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
se_run_men_001_1
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, Len, Luka, are you two gonna practice with me today?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you think, Akito? Don't we make for a bit of an unusual trio?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah, I guess since you usually stick together with Rin.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The thing is, we've been shuffling things up lately by playing rock paper scissors alright!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Rock paper scissors alright...?
How does that work?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Your team has four members, right?
So, we came up with a new way to break up into four groups!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I get that part...
But what's the gesture for “alright”?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You stick out your thumb and your index and middle fingers like this! And you gotta say it like you mean it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't ask about that last part!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha! You just have to go with the flow!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In other words, there's no real reason behind it.

rows.Speaker: Len & Luka
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, can we start practicing now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, we're ready whenever♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm at their mercy every time I do this with them.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I still need to do my best to not let them influence the way I sing.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, full speed right out of the gates!
Then, I'll do the same♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! It's the same part but with a new spin!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, Akito, I'm also gonna go all out!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You better. And I'm not about to let you guys steal the spotlight!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Thank you, Luka.
That was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You too, Len.
That ended up being a great practice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I also need to thank you! Hearing you come up with all those different variations was so cool♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But the way you two sang was the reason I was able to do that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys kept pushing me to do better and keep going.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I still think it's strange just how much I'm affected by the way Len and the others sing.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Actually, it's not just their singing. They've also given me tons of words of encouragement...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Is that all you wanted to say...?
If so, I'm gonna...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter, Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After we touched those black fragments and got stuck in that dream, I heard your voices.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. I didn't know who was talking at the time, but I know now. It was you and Rin.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Cool...!
That means we actually managed to reach you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank goodness! We kept calling your names in the hopes that you'd all come back to us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait... The entire time we were in that dream?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Initially, we thought you were faking being asleep, so we tried slapping you over and over.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why would you do that in an emergency?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Haha! I was kidding♪
But we did call your names nonstop.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But if I hadn't heard their voices...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Len, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for continuing to call out our names and believing that we'd be able to find a way out.

rows.Speaker: Len & Luka
rows.Line: You're welcome!
